results.title: Customize the bottom toolbar
results.checks: Account → Toolbar: untick Today and move Notes up; the bottom toolbar drops Today and shows Notes before Discover; kept after a reload; Reset restores it
results.note: 10 buttons; Today hidden and Notes before Discover, kept after a reload; Reset restored

results.title: The bottom toolbar fits its window, in Firefox and Chrome
results.checks: In Firefox and in Chrome, at 1440, 1100, 900 and 740 px wide: every button sits inside the bar and on screen, and the bar keeps clear of the sidebar; where the whole bar is wider than the reading area it folds under More, and More opens on screen and clear of the sidebar; widened to 1600 px the bar unfolds again
results.note: every button inside the bar, clear of the sidebar: firefox at 1440px whole; firefox at 1100px folded under More; firefox at 900px folded under More; firefox at 740px folded under More; chromium at 1440px whole; chromium at 1100px folded under More; chromium at 900px folded under More; chromium at 740px folded under More

results.title: A phone: the bar at the top, the page scrolls, sign-in stands out
results.checks: On an iPhone 13: the reader's bar sits at the top; the Tabs drawer closes with its ✕ and with a tap beside it; reading down scrolls the page itself (so the browser's bars can fold away); signed out, the sign-in button is filled in the accent colour and keeps its account icon with a highlight waiting (the count on its corner), and More opens with a Sign in button first that opens the sign-in pane
results.note: bar at y=8; the Tabs drawer closed by ✕ and by a tap beside it; the page scrolled; sign-in filled (rgb(224, 123, 76)) and kept its icon with a highlight waiting; More → Sign in opened the sign-in pane
